description: Registered live contributors (the live door, ASC-D6). Each row names a component's Contributor adapter, the when: it applies under (keys from when-keys.v2.json), its owner, a byte budget and a timeout. A contributor that fails or times out is left out and listed in dropped[] (fail open). Empty until the rotation handoff joins (plan 261122-1946 phase 7).

when.description: Fact key to allowed values (any-of); several keys all must match; empty means always.

owner.description: A component of the authority model.
